title: arctanthemum integrifolium
intro: Arctanthemum integrifolium, commonly known as Wolf's Bane, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The health benefits of Arctanthemum integrifolium include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help soothe digestive issues and relieve respiratory distress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as relaxing muscles and reducing inflammation.
